Dower or curtesy interests The value of the gross estate shall include the value of all property to the extent of any interest therein of the surviving spouse, existing at the time of the decedent's death as dower or curtesy, or by virtue of a statute creating an estate in lieu of dower or curtesy. (Aug. 16, 1954, ch. 736, 68A Stat. 381 ; Pub. L. 87–834, §18(a)(2)(B), Oct. 16, 1962, 76 Stat. 1052 .)

entries: Pub. L. 87–834 struck out provisions which excepted real property situated outside of the United States.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1962 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 87–834 applicable to estates of decedents dying after Oct. 16, 1962, except as otherwise provided, see section 18(b) of Pub. L. 87–834, set out as a note under section 2031 of this title.
